tools.name: adjust_for_inflation
tools.description: Compare GBP purchasing power between years, with prices, wages and housing context. RPI covers 1948 onwards; CPI covers 1988 onwards. "now" means the latest stored observation, not a live price.

tools.name: calculate_take_home
tools.description: Employee income tax and National Insurance for 2026/27, or the gross salary needed for a target net income. England, Wales and Northern Ireland only; Scotland is unsupported. Excludes pensions, student loans, benefits and other income. Includes a historical UK taxpayer income rank.

tools.name: compare_public_spending
tools.description: Express a GBP amount as a share and duration of a stored 2025-26 public budget, with comparisons against other budgets. The NHS comparison uses England's DHSC day-to-day budget as a proxy. These are illustrative averages, not live spending rates.
